name: Crystal Calamity
detailed_description:
Upcoming Update:

- New Character: Martial Artist.

- New Mechanic: Seize enemy intentions and turn them into your own cards.

- New Feature: Undo actions—freely adjust your strategy at any time, no more worries about misclicks.

- UI & Improvements: Enhanced enemy intent UI, character status UI, equipment UI, and more.

- Visual Updates: Major revamps for shop, black market, campfire, and other interfaces.

Game Overview

"Crystal Calamity" is a roguelike deck-building and tactical RPG that fuses the spirit of "Slay the Spire" with the strategic depth of "Into the Breach." You play as the leader of an adventurer squad, but after a fateful mission and a sinister conspiracy, you are framed for the murder of a high-ranking official. Stripped of your powers and with your team destroyed, you find yourself at rock bottom.

In this moment of despair, a spirit from another world saves you. With the power of the Leviathan Crystal, you gain the ability to traverse time and space. To reclaim your strength, rescue your companions, and perhaps even save the world, you must journey to the royal capital and uncover the thousand-year-old secrets hidden within the Leviathan Crystal.

The road ahead is perilous. But with another chance, can you change fate itself?

Powerful Companions

In the full release, you’ll command at least four playable heroes, each joining you on your quest to save the world. Every character boasts a solo deck of at least 75 cards and their own special mechanics.

Not only will you have loyal companions, but also adorable spirits from another realm. Swept into this world by temporal rifts, these spirits are scattered around the capital. Find them and help them return home.

As your trusty allies, spirits serve as your draw and discard piles, fighting by your side. You must protect them in battle and use their unique abilities at the right moment to turn the tide. Each spirit has different powers, and you can choose the ones that best suit your strategy for each journey.

Relics

On your journey, you’ll encounter nearly 200 unique relics, and your companions can collect close to 400 cards. These are the hard-earned treasures from countless time loops. Choosing and collecting them wisely is key to saving the world.

Enemies

Temporal rifts bring not only spirits, but also terrifying creatures from other worlds—ferocious beings that destroy everything in their path.

Yet, monsters aren’t your only threat. As a wanted fugitive, everyone is watching your every move, and powerful factions clash all around you. On this journey, you never know who is friend or foe. You’ll need to learn, manipulate, and even deceive others—for the sake of your companions, and for the world itself.
